text:
Laura Chen: Hey team — idea for All-Hands Week: set up 2 pop-up recognition kiosks where people can drop quick kudos and issue spot awards on the spot. 2-3hr windows each day. :tada:
Mike Patel: love this. Is this the physical tablet + card concept or a QR -> form flow?
Laura Chen: tablet mostly (iPad) w/ a short form. Also QR fallback for line overflow. goal is <1 minute per person.
Anika Gomez: we have 2 spare iPads in office inventory. Need to reserve the south lobby table and 2 chairs. I'll check room booking.
Priya Singh: I'll own the ops for the kiosks (volunteer signups, training doc, and script). Can someone confirm budget for gift cards / spot awards?
James R: Finance check — we can fund spot awards up to $400 per week for culture events, but any single award >$200 needs approval. Also need PO for bulk purchase of $25 gift cards.
Laura Chen: noted. Targeting 50 quick kudos redemptions across week, avg $20 — should be under budget.
Mike Patel: can we use the existing Spot Awards code? people-bot can issue codes, right?
people-bot: Reminder: use `/issue-spot-award <recipient> <amount> <reason>` to create awards. For events, please tag `#people-ops` for tracking.
Priya Singh: thanks — planning sheet here: https://docs.google.com/sheetseventkiosks (edited)
Priya Singh: draft schedule below for review:
```
Mon 10:00-12:00 south lobby - Engineering
Tue 14:00-16:00 north atrium - Product
Wed 11:00-13:00 south lobby - Sales
Thu 15:00-17:00 cafe - Ops + Finance
Fri 09:00-11:00 south lobby - Open
```
Anika Gomez: I'll reserve the south lobby for Mon/Wed/Fri. cafe is ok for Thu but need catering sign-off for footprint.
Mike Patel: volunteers — can we get 2 per shift? I'll ping eng leads for rota.
Priya Singh: volunteer signup tab is in the sheet. Also prepping 2 short scripts: one for kiosk greeter, one for tablet helper.
James R: procurement: for 50x $25 cards = $1,250. Submit the PO before Thurs so we get cards before event. If digital cards, ensure vendor supports bulk CSV upload.
Laura Chen: can someone make a small poster + QR code we can print? I'll send copy.
Priya Singh: poster mock below, will coordinate printing with Anika. Also can we have a small bucket for quick handwritten notes to paste on the 'kudos wall'?
Mike Patel: love the wall idea. quick ask: do we need legal sign-off for public photos at the kiosk? we sometimes want to take pics for IG.
Anika Gomez: yes, we'll put a small consent checkbox on the tablet form.
Laura Chen: action items: Priya submit PO request + sheet updated by Wed EOD; Anika reserves spaces and prints posters; Mike secures volunteers; James confirms vendor details by Thurs.
Priya Singh: will do. thanks y'all :sparkles:
people-bot: Event reminder scheduled: "Kiosk setup checklist" will post 48h before each shift.
James R: approved budget in principle. Please cc me on the PO.
Laura Chen: perfect. if anyone has creative props (stickers, mini trophies) drop in the sheet.
Mike Patel: I'll check our swag closet. :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: closing thread for now, will reopen if any blockers.
